dct_title_s: [Tabulam hanc Aegypti, si æquus ac Diligens Lector, cum Alys, quæ Hactenus Prodicūt...]
dct_description_sm: Bar scale on map given in ["Milliarium Italica"].
Decorative cartouches (empty), compass rose, ships, sea monster and other fauna.
Lower and upper halves of map appear separately, each with a containing border (lower half includes title, index, and bar scale).
Appears in Bry's Petits voyages, part I, 1606.
Pencil inscription in lower left: 24 upper.
